Events and programs

All events are free. Registration is required where noted; call (555) 010-0242 or use the registration links below. Assistive listening devices are available at every branch.

September 2026

  • Author talk: Nadia Osman, The Orchard Year

    Thursday, Sept 3, 6:30 PM · Central Branch, Community Room

    Nadia Osman discusses her debut novel about four generations of a farming family, followed by an audience Q&A and signing.

    Register for the Nadia Osman author talk on September 3

  • Teen coding club: intro to Python

    Tuesday, Sept 8, 4:00 PM · Eastside Branch, Tech Lab

    Eight-week series for ages 12–16. Laptops provided; no experience needed. Sessions are capped at 14 participants.

    Register for the teen coding club starting September 8

  • Bilingual story time (English/Spanish)

    Saturday, Sept 12, 10:30 AM · Northgate Branch, Children's Room

    Stories, songs, and rhymes for ages 2–5 with their caregivers. Drop-in; no registration needed.

    Event details for bilingual story time on September 12

Accessibility at our events

All branches are wheelchair accessible. American Sign Language interpretation and live captioning (CART) are available with seven days' notice — request them on any registration page. Large-print and braille event guides can be collected at the Central Branch service desk. Service animals are always welcome.
